actuals_average: Check occurrence: noun (the average value) or adjective.
actuals_clear: Verb — to clear a selection or filter. Not the adjective "clear/obvious".
baseline_generated: Status label — past participle, a forecast that exists.
baseline_none: Seasonality label — no repeating pattern. Means "none detected", not the pronoun.
baseline_recurring: Seasonality label — a repeating pattern was detected. Adjective.
baseline_volume: Tab label — the volume-events tab. Noun.
bulk_algorithm: Column heading naming the forecasting algorithm.
bulk_done: Button label confirming completion. Not the adjective.
bulkdrawer_done: Button label confirming completion. Not the adjective.
compare_clear: Verb — to clear a selection or filter. Not the adjective "clear/obvious".
compare_processing: Transient status shown while a file loads.
hierdrop_collapse: Verb — close an expanded tree node.
hierdrop_expand: Verb — open a collapsed tree node.
mapping_done: Button label confirming completion. Not the adjective.
multiselect_clear: Verb — to clear a selection or filter. Not the adjective "clear/obvious".
overall_clear: Verb — to clear a selection or filter. Not the adjective "clear/obvious".
overall_forecasted: Status/series label — the forecast series, as opposed to actuals.
overall_missing: Status label — a forecast that has not been generated.
overall_view: Ambiguous in English. Check the occurrence: verb (action button, "view this cohort") or noun (column heading / mode selector).
whatif_both: Scope selector value shown to the user — applies to both Inflow and Retention. Adjective/pronoun, not the conjunction.
whatif_cohorts: Noun, plural — the pricing target is cohorts rather than the standing base.
whatif_complete: Check occurrence: adjective/status ("complete") or verb ("complete this step").
whatif_even: Distribution type — spread equally across months. Not the adverb "even".
whatif_export: Check occurrence: verb (action button) or noun (an export).
whatif_one_off: Event duration — applies to a single month only.
whatif_only: Adverb used as a button label — "show only this series". Not the adjective "only one". Keep it short; it sits inside a small pill.
whatif_pricing: Tab label — the pricing-events tab. Gerund used as a noun.
whatif_promotion: Tab label — the custom promotion tab. Noun.
whatif_recurring: Seasonality label — a repeating pattern was detected. Adjective.
whatif_show_only_kpi: Full sentence for the button's tooltip and screen-reader label. {{kpi}} is an untranslated series name (Inflow / Outflow / Retention / Base / ARPU) — see TERMBASE §1.
whatif_tier: Value tier (Product L2 band), as opposed to Tariff. Noun.
whatif_use: Verb — "use this value". Not the noun.
whatif_value: Tab label — the value/mix tab. Noun, not the verb.
whatif_view: Ambiguous in English. Check the occurrence: verb (action button, "view this cohort") or noun (column heading / mode selector).
whatif_volume: Tab label — the volume-events tab. Noun.
